contracts.commit_point: open(file_path, 'w') followed by f.write(content) in update_file_content (update_file_content.py:14-15).
contracts.declared_mechanism: Absolute-path precondition inside the @agent.tool-decorated fix_file wrapper: a comprehension flags every non-absolute item.file_path (setup.py:140-144) and ModelRetry is raised before fix_file_operation is called (setup.py:146-148, dispatch at setup.py:150).
contracts.forbidden_condition: A fix item whose file_path fails Path.is_absolute() reaching fix_file_operation/update_file_content and being written to disk; the registered tool must intercept such items with ModelRetry before dispatch (setup.py:140-148).
pending_binding_information: Behavior after ModelRetry retries are exhausted (Agent retries=2 at setup.py:69) - i.e., whether any write can still occur on repeated invalid paths - depends on run_agent_operation, which is not in supplied views.
Whether the guarded effect should additionally be confined to the session working directory is a policy threshold not declared in source.

update_file_content swallows write exceptions and returns None (update_file_content.py:17-19) while fix_file_operation records fix_applied=True (fix_file.py:18-21); whether post-commit failures must be surfaced before reporting success is not declared.
contracts.protected_operation: Applying agent-proposed code fixes: the fix_file tool's dispatch to fix_file_operation (setup.py:150) and its per-fix write through update_file_content (fix_file.py:14-17).
contracts.protected_resource: Files addressed by agent-supplied item.file_path values in FixFileParam.fixes, written via update_file_content.
contracts.protection_obligation: The registered fix_file agent tool must reject (raise ModelRetry) any fix whose file_path is not an absolute path before fix_file_operation/update_file_content writes corrected content to disk.
scope_limits: The guard checks only Path.is_absolute(); absolute paths outside the session working directory (including paths into the root project or elsewhere on the filesystem) pass the guard and reach the write.
The precondition lives solely in the registered tool wrapper; update_file_content performs no path validation itself (update_file_content.py:5-19).
The check is all-or-nothing across data.fixes before any write occurs; no partial subset of fixes is written ahead of a failing item.
The sibling absolute-path check in the read_file tool (setup.py:98-122) and the run_code execution tool (setup.py:86-95) are distinct operations not covered by this contract.

contracts.commit_point: shutil.copy2(source, dest) overwriting the root project file at debug_session.py:102, with dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) at debug_session.py:101 establishing the target location.
contracts.declared_mechanism: Interactive consent gate confirm_sync_back() (questionary.confirm in prompts.py:57-72) evaluated at commands.py:132, followed by create_backup_for_root() writing a .bak copy of each modified root file (debug_session.py:121-142), both sequenced before session.sync_back_to_root() at commands.py:133-134.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Overwriting a file in the user's root project directory via sync_back_to_root (shutil.copy2 of a session working copy onto config.root_directory / relative_path) when confirm_sync_back() has not returned True in the same CLI run, or when create_backup_for_root has not first written a .bak copy for that pre-existing target file.
pending_binding_information: Whether questionary.confirm's default=True (prompts.py:63) satisfies an 'explicit confirmation' requirement is a policy determination not decidable from supplied source.
create_backup_for_root catches and logs backup failures without aborting (debug_session.py:141-142); whether the sync must be blocked when any backup fails is not declared in source.

sync_back_to_root reloads the session from stackloop.config. on disk when present (debug_session.py:86-90); whether the reloaded modified_files set is guaranteed to equal the agent-generated fix list cannot be verified from supplied views.
contracts.protected_operation: Syncing agent-fixed session files back to the root project directory (DebugSession.sync_back_to_root, invoked only after the confirm_sync_back gate at commands.py:132-134).
contracts.protected_resource: Files under the user's root project directory (config.root_directory / relative_path for each entry in session.modified_files).
contracts.protection_obligation: Fixed session files must not be copied back to the user's root project directory unless the user explicitly confirms via confirm_sync_back(), and each target file must have a .bak backup created before the overwrite commit point (shutil.copy2 in sync_back_to_root).
scope_limits: The gate and backup are enforced only at the CLI call site (commands.py:131-134); sync_back_to_root and create_backup_for_root perform no confirmation or backup check internally.
Applies only to files listed in session.modified_files; other files in the working directory or root project are not covered.

Backup creation is skipped for root targets that do not already exist (debug_session.py:136-140) while the sync still creates those targets (debug_session.py:101-102); the .bak precondition binds only to pre-existing files.
Does not govern the agent fix_file tool's writes to session working-directory copies; only the root-overwrite sync effect is in scope for this contract.
